headings.description: Bubbly, bold, playful but highly readable. Perfect for a children's party aesthetic. Used for Hero headings, Section titles, and prominent numbers in KPIs.

body.description: Rounded, approachable sans-serif font that pairs well with Fredoka but scales down excellently for dense UI (tables, calendars, form inputs).

rules: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans anywhere.
Never center-align long dense text; stick to left alignment for readability.
Dashboard: Maximum text size text-3xl for headers to maintain data density.

primary.description: Vibrant Energy Orange. Used for primary CTAs (Book Now, Login, Primary actions).

secondary.description: Bubblegum Pink. Used for secondary accents, playful highlights, status tags (e.g., Pending), and 'New/Hot' tags.

tertiary.description: Deep Professional Blue. Used for the Admin dashboard sidebar, text-heavy contrast, and trust-building components (contracts/payments).

background.description: Warm off-white for the public site to feel inviting. Cool slate-50 for dashboard to feel professional and clean.

rules: Avoid purple-on-white AI slop combinations completely.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds on overlays or headers (use bg-white/80 with backdrop-blur-xl).
Always set hover text color explicitly (e.g., hover:bg-orange-600 hover:text-white).

visual_enhancers.corners: Extensively use rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for cards/images to mimic the soft, inflated look of bounce houses.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft, diffused drop shadows (shadow-lg shadow-orange-500/10) rather than harsh gray shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use subtle 1px borders (border-orange-100 or border-blue-100) to define edges in the dashboard.

public_portal.hero: Asymmetric bento grid featuring a large image of a bounce house on one side, and highly contrasting playful text on the other. Use wide margins (px-6 md:px-12).
public_portal.catalog: Generous spacing (gap-8). Cards should be highly visual, allocating 70% height to the image and 30% to the details/CTA.
public_portal.spacing_scale: p-8, p-12, p-16 to give the design 'breathing room'.

dashboard.structure: Sidebar navigation (Blue base, white text) with a dense, white-background main content area.
dashboard.spacing_scale: Tighter (p-4, p-6). Data density is important here.
dashboard.grids: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 for KPI cards.

component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Must include micro-interactions (e.g., hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md transition-transform duration-200).
component_guidelines.cards: Cardless style for dashboard tables. For public portal, soft rounded cards (rounded-3xl) with subtle border.
component_guidelines.calendar: Color-coded events (Pink = Pending, Blue = Confirmed, Orange = In Progress). Use shadcn calendar but override standard square corners to rounded-xl.
component_guidelines.forms: Inputs must have rounded-xl borders, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-400. Soft grey placeholder text.
component_guidelines.tables: Dashboard tables should have generous padding inside cells (p-4), subtle border-b for rows, no outer card wrap.

motion: Page Loads: Staggered fade-in-up for lists (toys catalog).
accessibility: Test all text for WCAG AA contrast (e.g., white text on the bright orange might need an orange-600 shade).
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute based on their role.
Provide clear focus rings on all inputs/buttons.

image_urls.description: Vibrant Disney Princess-themed bouncy castle set up outdoors
A red inflatable castle bounce house on a grassy lawn

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not center align text by default (no .App { text-align: center; }).
Do not use transparent backgrounds behind text or in headers.
Always apply data-testid to critical interactive elements.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide icons, DO NOT use emojis as icons.
Ensure dark text is used against light backgrounds, never assume inherited colors.
